blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Advancing spatial intelligence in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is bottlenecked by the scarcity of complex, scalable 3D question-answer (QA) data. While manual annotation is labor-intensive, directly utilizing LLMs to synthesize these QA pairs often fails due to their inherent deficiencies in spatial and geometric computation. We introduce Exemplar2VQA , a scalable exemplar-driven visual question answering generation framework that rapidly synthesizes large-scale spatial QA pairs in simulated environments via multi-agent coding. By equipping collaborative agents with a meticulously designed library of geometric utilities, Exemplar2VQA bypasses LLMs’ spatial reasoning flaws through deterministic code execution. Crucially, the framework exhibits remarkable versatility: taking diverse static object-centric spatial query templates as exemplars, it seamlessly and autonomously scales them into massive, high-fidelity synthetic datasets. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL (3B/7B) exclusively on Exemplar2VQA-generated synthetic indoor data yields significant performance improvements across various diverse benchmarks. Furthermore, its effectiveness is not limited to in-domain indoor datasets but also robustly extends to outdoor and mixed-scene benchmarks. These results establish Exemplar2VQA as a scalable and powerful paradigm for bridging the sim-to-real gap in Embodied AI. Our code is at https://github.com/yingjiayu12/Exemplar2VQA .
blocks.zh: 在多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)中推进空间智能,被复杂,可扩展的3D问答(QA)数据的稀缺所瓶颈. 虽然人工注释是劳动密集型的,但直接使用LLMs合成这些QA对往往由于在空间和几何计算中固有的缺陷而失败. 我们引入了Exemplar2VQA,一个可扩展的由exemplar驱动的视觉问题解答生成框架,通过多剂编码在模拟环境中快速合成了大规模空间QA对. Exemplar2VQA通过为协作代理人配备精密设计的几何工具库,通过定型代码执行绕过LLMs的空间推理缺陷. 关键是,这个框架展现出显著的多功能性:将不同的静态以物体为中心的空间查询模板作为示例,它无缝和自主地将其缩放成大规模高纯度合成数据集. 仅以Exemplar2VQA生成的室内合成数据作精细调取Quen2.5-VL(3B/7B),在各种基准中产生显著的性能改进. 此外,其效力不仅限于室内内部数据集,而且还大力扩展至室外和混合场景基准。 这些结果将Exemplar2VQA确立为缩小Embody AI中模拟到实际差距的可扩展而强大的范式. 我们的代码在https://github.com/yingjiayu12/Exemplar2VQA上 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Spatial intelligence is crucial for MLLMs in Embodied AI, yet its advancement is severely bottlenecked by a scarcity of large-scale, high-quality 3D spatial QA datasets [ 1 ] . Traditional manual annotation is prohibitively costly and unscalable. Conversely, using LLMs or VLMs to autonomously synthesize this frequently yields severe hallucinations [ 2 ] . This stems from an inherent flaw: while proficient in language, LLMs lack deterministic geometric computational abilities, making them incapable of accurately grounding physical attributes like occlusion and allocentric viewpoints [ 3 ] . While multi-agent frameworks untangle this complexity by decomposing tasks [ 4 , 5 ] , merely distributing the workload fails to resolve LLMs’ fundamental inability to perform precise spatial arithmetic.
blocks.zh: 空间情报对健美AI的MLLMS至关重要,然而其进步却被大量,高品质的3D空间QA数据集的稀缺性所严重瓶颈. [1]. 传统的人工说明费用高得令人望而却步。 反之,利用LLMs或VLMs自动合成,往往产生严重的幻觉[2]. 这源于一个固有的缺陷:LLMs虽然精通语言,但缺乏决定性的几何计算能力,使其无法准确地打下诸如被隔离和偏心观点等物理属性的基础[3]. 虽然多代理框架通过分解任务[4,5]来解开这种复杂性,但仅仅分配工作量并不能解决LLMs根本无法进行精确空间算术的问题。

blocks.en: Consequently, synthesizing high-fidelity 3D spatial QA datasets at scale presents three formidable challenges: (1) The Data Acquisition Bottleneck: Traditional manual annotation is fundamentally unscalable and cost-prohibitive when dealing with complex, multi-view 3D geometries. (2) The Spatial Hallucination Dilemma: Directly prompting LLMs to deduce spatial attributes is highly prone to yielding logically flawed data [ 6 ] . (3) The Rigidity of Existing Pipelines: Beyond the prevalent issue of hallucinations, current automated spatial generation methods are typically governed by fixed, hardcoded rules. They strictly lack the extensibility to dynamically adapt to user-defined abstract intents or flexibly generate customized QA pairs that align with diverse, specific structural formats.
blocks.zh: 因此,大规模合成高可靠性的3D空间QA数据集提出了三个严峻的挑战: (1)"数据获取 Bottleneck":传统的手动注释在处理复杂多视图3D几何时,基本上是无法缩放并禁止成本的. (2) 空间幻觉困境: 直接促使LLMs推导出空间属性极易产生逻辑上有缺陷的数据[6]. (3)"现有管道的刚性":除了普遍存在的幻觉问题外,目前的自动空间生成方法一般受固定的,有硬码的规则所制约. 它们严格缺乏可扩展性,无法动态地适应用户定义的抽象意图,或灵活地生成符合不同具体结构格式的定制的QA对.

blocks.en: To address these formidable challenges, we propose Exemplar2VQA, designed to synthesize large-scale spatial QA pairs in simulated environments (Figure 1 , Figure 2 ) without manual annotation. At the core of this synthesis process is the utilization of spatial QA exemplars as foundational blueprints. If a user wishes to construct a specific category of spatial questions, they merely need to provide a concrete QA pair as a exemplar. This exemplar functions provides a clear schema for the pipeline by explicitly defining the desired structural format, specific object parameters, and logical comparison targets. Our pipeline then autonomously scales this user-defined intent into a massive dataset. This seamless scaling from user-defined seeds effectively resolves the rigidity of existing automated pipelines. Guided by these templates, instead of forcing LLMs to generate linguistic spatial answers directly, our framework employs a collaborative multi-agent system that translates spatial reasoning tasks into executable Python scripts. Instead of forcing a monolithic model to suffer severe cognitive overload by simultaneously juggling semantic parsing, code generation, along with review and refinement, our collaborative compartmentalizes these distinct tasks into specialized agent roles. This decoupled architecture effectively dismantles the bottleneck of single-agent systems: it prevents the context contamination and compounding errors that inevitably occur when abstract linguistic intents are mixed with mathematical execution in a single prompt. By ensuring each agent maintains a highly focused reasoning window, this framework enables targeted, module-specific self-correction, thereby drastically improving the robustness and overall execution success rate [ 7 ] . Furthermore, by leveraging interactive environmental feedback from a physics-enabled simulator [ 8 , 9 ] , the agents can perform physics-constrained self-correction [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 ] . This code-driven paradigm allows Exemplar2VQA to effectively bypass the inherent spatial reasoning flaws of conventional LLMs to derive reliable ground-truth answers [ 14 , 15 , 16 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些令人生畏的挑战,我们提出Exemplar2VQA,旨在模拟环境中合成大规模空间QA对(图1,图2)而无需人工注释. 这一合成过程的核心是利用空间QA实例作为基础蓝图. 如果用户希望构建一个特定类别的空间问题,他们只需要提供一对混凝土QA作为示例. 这个示例函数通过明确界定所期望的结构格式,特定对象参数,逻辑比较目标,为管道提供了明确的计划. 我们的输油管然后自动地将这个用户定义的意图放大成一个庞大的数据集. 这种从用户定义的种子中无缝的缩放有效解决了现有自动管的刚性. 在这些模板的指引下,我们的框架没有强迫LLMs直接生成语言空间答案,而是采用了协作多代理系统,将空间推理任务转化为可执行的Python脚本. 与其通过同时将语义解析、代码生成与审查和完善结合起来,强迫单一模型承受严重的认知超载,不如把这些独特的任务分成专门的代理角色。 这种脱钩的架构能有效去除单剂系统的瓶颈:它能防止上下文被污染和复合出错,而当抽象语言意图与数学执行相混合于一个单一的快板时,这些错误不可避免地会发生. 通过确保每个代理人都有一个高度集中的推理窗口,这个框架能够有针对性地、针对模块的自我矫正,从而大幅度地提高稳健性和总体执行成功率[7]。 此外,通过利用物理学模拟器[8、9]的交互式环境反馈,物剂可以进行物理学自律[10、11、12、13]。 这种由代码驱动的范式使得Exemplar2VQA能够有效地绕过常规LLMs固有的空间推理缺陷来得出可靠的地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地的答案[14,15,16].

blocks.en: To empirically validate the efficacy of our generated data, we fine-tune open-weight multimodal large language models, Qwen2.5-VL (3B and 7B) [ 17 ] , exclusively on the synthetic indoor data generated by Exemplar2VQA. The experimental results demonstrate substantial improvements not only on in-domain indoor benchmarks. Without seeing any outdoor training samples, the Exemplar2VQA-enhanced models successfully transfer their acquired spatial intelligence to strictly outdoor and comprehensive mixed-scene environments. Furthermore, our approach effectively outperforms baselines fine-tuned on human-annotated real-world datasets, underscoring a highly successful sim-to-real transfer [ 18 , 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了从经验上验证我们生成的数据的功效,我们微调了开放式多式大型语言模型Quen2.5-VL(3B和7B)[17],完全在Exemplar2VQA生成的室内合成数据上. 实验结果表明,不仅在室内内部基准方面有重大改进。 在没有看到任何户外训练样本的情况下,Exemplar2VQA增强型成功将获得的空间智能转移到了严格的户外综合混合环境. 此外,我们的方法有效地超过了人类附加说明的现实世界数据集的基线,突出了高度成功的 " 向实际转移 " [18、19]。

blocks.en: In summary, the main contributions of this work are threefold: • An Exemplar-Driven Multi-Agent Spatial VQA Framework: We introduce Exemplar2VQA, an end-to-end, fully automated VQA generation framework. By equipping collaborative agents with a meticulously designed library of geometric utilities and physics-constrained environmental feedback, Exemplar2VQA effectively resolves the inherent spatial computation deficiencies of LLMs through deterministic mathematical execution. • High Extensibility and Autonomous Scaling: We demonstrate the exceptional versatility of Exemplar2VQA, showing that it can seamlessly adapt a broad spectrum of static object-centric spatial query exemplars from existing benchmarks and autonomously scale them into massive, high-quality synthetic datasets without manual intervention. • Robust Sim-to-Real and OOD Generalization: Through extensive evaluations across diverse benchmarks, we validate that models fine-tuned solely on Exemplar2VQA’s synthetic indoor data achieve extraordinary cross-domain spatial intelligence. This establishes a powerful, scalable, and cost-effective new paradigm for acquiring high-fidelity spatial data to advance Embodied AI.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,这项工作的主要贡献有三: 示范-驱动多剂空间VQA 框架: 我们引入了Exemplar2VQA,一个端到端,完全自动化的VQA生成框架. Exemplar2VQA为协作代理人配备了精密设计的几何公用和物理学所制约的环境反馈库,通过确定数学执行,有效解决了LLMs固有的空间计算缺陷. • 高度可扩展性和自主扩展性: 我们展示了Exemplar2VQA的特有多用途性,显示它能够从现有基准中无缝地将一幅以静态物体为中心的空间查询大相径庭地调整,并在没有人工干预的情况下自主地将其缩放成大规模而高质量的合成数据集. • 强健的Sim-to-Real和OOD通则: 通过对各种基准的广泛评估,我们验证了仅对Exemplar2VQA合成室内数据进行精细调整的模型能够实现非凡的跨域空间智能。 这确立了一种强大、可扩展和具有成本效益的新模式,以获取高真实度的空间数据来推进人工智能。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Spatial Understanding in Vision-Language Models has rapidly evolved from single-image reasoning [ 20 ] to complex multi-view and cross-image scenarios [ 3 , 21 , 22 ] . To systematically diagnose spatial intelligence, recent benchmarks such as UniQA-3D [ 23 ] , ViewSpatial-Bench [ 24 ] , and Multi-SpatialMLLM [ 25 ] have shifted focus towards 3D and video-based environments. Notably, Yang et al. [26] conducted comprehensive evaluations on VSI-Bench, revealing a stark reality: even advanced commercial MLLMs perform mediocrely on 3D spatial tasks. Existing spatial datasets face a critical dilemma: they either rely on fully human-curated annotations—such as MMSI-Bench proposed by Yang et al. [27] , or depend on rigid, rule-based generation [ 28 ] .
blocks.zh: 视野-语言模型中的空间理解已经从单相图推理[20]迅速发展为复杂的多相图和交叉相图情景[3,21,22]. 为了系统地分析空间情报,UniQA-3D [23], ViewSpatial-Bench [24],和多空间MLM [25]等近期基准将重点转移到了3D和视频环境上. 值得注意的是,杨等. [26] 对VSI-Bench进行了全面的评价,揭示出一个严峻的现实:即使是先进的商业MLLM也在3D空间任务上平庸地执行. 现有的空间数据集面临一个严峻的两难境地:要么依靠完全人性的精确说明,如杨等提出的MMSI-Bench[27],要么依靠僵硬的、有章可循的生成[28]。

blocks.en: Automated Synthetic Data Generation has emerged as a transformative paradigm to circumvent the prohibitive costs of manual annotation. Pioneering frameworks, such as LLaVA [ 29 ] and ShareGPT4V [ 30 ] , have successfully leveraged powerful models like GPT-4 to autonomously synthesize large-scale multimodal instruction-tuning data. However, while this prompting-based synthesis excels in general semantic recognition, extending it to generate complex spatial QA pairs is notoriously problematic. When directly prompted to deduce precise 3D geometric relationships, MLLMs frequently suffer from severe spatial hallucinations [ 31 , 32 , 33 ] . Consequently, directly prompting them to implicitly “hallucinate” physical relationships yields spatial data riddled with logical inconsistencies. Exemplar2VQA completely subverts this flawed paradigm.
blocks.zh: 自动合成 数据生成已成为一种变革模式,可以避免人工注释的高昂成本。 LLaVA[29]和ShareGPT4V[30]等先行框架成功地利用了GPT-4等强大的模型,自主地合成了大型多模式指令调制数据. 然而,虽然这种以催化为基础的合成在一般语义识别方面优异,但将其延伸至生成复杂的空间QA对却臭名昭著地存在问题. 当直接促使推断出精确的3D几何关系时,MLLMs经常会遭受严重的空间幻觉[31,32,33]. 因此,直接促使它们隐含地“扼杀”物理关系产生充满逻辑上不一致的空间数据。 Exemplar2VQA完全颠覆了这个有缺陷的范式.

blocks.en: Embodied Environments and Sim-to-Real Transfer have become indispensable for scalable spatial learning in Embodied AI [ 34 ] . 3D physics-enabled simulators, such as AI2-THOR [ 8 ] and Habitat [ 9 ] , offer an unparalleled testbed for generating high-fidelity training data. These platforms provide cost-effective, infinitely scalable [ 35 , 36 ] , and fully controllable environments where perfect scene metadata can be effortlessly extracted to construct ground-truth spatial relationships [ 37 ] . Capitalizing on this pristine simulated data, Exemplar2VQA establishes a robust and deterministic foundation for spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh: 健康环境与Sim-to-Real Transfer已成为可伸缩空间学习所不可或缺的,见于"健康AI [34]. 三维物理驱动模拟器",如AI2-THOR [8]和Hibit [9],为生成高纯度培训数据提供了一个无与伦比的测试床. 这些平台提供了成本效益高、无限可扩展的[35、36]和完全可控制的环境,在这种环境中,可以不遗余力地提取完美的场景元数据来构建地面-真实的空间关系[37]。 Exemplar2VQA利用这一原始的模拟数据,为空间推理奠定了坚实和决定性的基础.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we present Exemplar2VQA. Designed for the autonomous synthesis of high-fidelity spatial QA datasets, Exemplar2VQA utilizes concrete spatial query exemplars as guiding seeds. We also detail the framework’s overarching design, including the deterministic geometric utilities API it employs and the multi-agent collaborative pipeline that drives the dual-track synthesis process [ 38 , 39 , 10 , 40 ] .
blocks.zh: 本节介绍Exemplar2VQA. 为高真能空间QA数据集的自主合成而设计,Exemplar2VQA利用混凝土空间查询实例作为引导种子. 我们还详细介绍了该框架的总体设计,包括它使用的确定性几何公用设施API和推动双轨合成进程的多代理协作管道[38、39、10、40]。

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem Formulation and Exemplar2VQA Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题制定和实例2VQA 概览

Here, 𝒱 i \mathcal{V}_{i} denotes a set of images captured according to the user-specified camera viewpoint requirements, Q i Q_{i} is the instantiated natural language question, and A i A_{i} is the ground-truth answer. Thus, the pipeline can be abstracted as 𝒟 = Φ E2V ​ ( 𝒮 , ℰ ) \mathcal{D}=\Phi_{\mathrm{E2V}}(\mathcal{S},\mathcal{E}) .

blocks.en: Crucially, by abstracting spatial reasoning into parameterized programmatic execution, Exemplar2VQA bypasses the constraints of rigid, rule-based generation. As demonstrated in Figure 2 , this architecture allows Exemplar2VQA to seamlessly adapt to a highly diverse spatial question taxonomy ℰ \mathcal{E} . From simple egocentric positioning to complex allocentric viewpoint reasoning and occlusion relationships, the framework autonomously scales these exemplars into massive, varied QA pairs, entirely eliminating the need for manual scripting.
blocks.zh: 关键是,通过将空间推理抽象入参数化的程序执行中,Exemplar2VQA绕过了刚性,有章可循的生成的限制. 如图2所示,这种架构使得Exemplar2VQA能够无缝地适应高度多样化的空间问题分类学 E\mathcal{E}. 从简单的自负式定位到复杂的同心取景推理和隐蔽关系,框架自动地将这些实例缩放成大规模,多变的QA对,完全消除了手动脚本化的需要.

blocks.en: 3.2 Dual-Track Multi-Agent Collaborative Coding
blocks.zh: 3.2 双轨多代理协作编码

blocks.en: To operationalize the deterministic mapping Φ E2V \Phi_{\mathrm{E2V}} , Exemplar2VQA orchestrates a logic-driven, dual-track multi-agent framework. Both tracks share a unified four-stage topology, but they operate within distinct execution environments to decouple embodied navigation from abstract spatial reasoning. All agents across both tracks are instantiated by a single foundational model: the open-source Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct [ 41 ] . By leveraging a highly capable yet parameter-efficient (30B) open-source model rather than relying on massive, opaque proprietary LLMs, Exemplar2VQA ensures both high accessibility and full reproducibility. The distinct agent roles are strictly enforced not by different model weights, but through specialized system prompts, compartmentalized contextual memory, and track-specific tool access. This homogeneous design maintains consistent programmatic proficiency across the pipeline while preventing the context contamination that typically plagues monolithic agents.
blocks.zh: 要运行确定性映射 E2V\Phi_{\-mathrm{E2V}}},Exemplar2VQA会协调一个由逻辑驱动的双轨多代理框架. 这两道轨道都有一个统一的四相地貌,但它们在不同的执行环境中运行,从抽象的空间推理中去掉已包含的导航. 两个音轨上的所有代理都由单一的基础模型即时化:开源Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct [41]. Exemplar2VQA通过利用一个能力强但有参数效率的(30B)开源模型,而不是依赖大规模,不透明的专有LLMS,确保高可访问性和完全可再生性. 不同的代理角色不是通过不同的模型权重来严格执行,而是通过专门的系统提示,分割上下文内存,以及田径专用工具访问. 这种同质设计在整个管道中保持一贯的方案熟练程度,同时防止通常困扰单一物剂的环境污染。

blocks.en: 3.3 Geometric API Orchestration
blocks.zh: 3.3 几何API管弦

blocks.en: To bridge the gap between abstract spatial reasoning and physical reality, Exemplar2VQA equips the multi-agent system with a meticulously engineered library of deterministic geometric utilities. As fundamentally auto-regressive models, LLMs notoriously struggle with complex matrix transformations, and precise 3D geometric intersections, which are the primary catalysts for spatial hallucinations. Exemplar2VQA circumvents this architectural limitation by strictly offloading all rigorous geometric computations to a Python-based execution environment.
blocks.zh: 为了弥合抽象空间推理与物理现实之间的差距,Exemplar2VQA为多代理系统配备了精心设计的确定几何功能库. 作为本质上的自发后退模型,LLMS臭名昭著地与复杂的矩阵变换和精确的3D几何相交相相抗衡,这些是空间幻觉的主要催化剂. Exemplar2VQA通过将所有严格的几何计算严格卸入基于Python的执行环境来规避这种建筑限制.

blocks.en: Code 1: Selected Exemplar2VQA Geometric API .
blocks.zh: 码 1 : 选取 Exemplar2VQA 几何 API .

blocks.en: As formalized in Code 1 , we expose a structured hierarchy of spatial API signatures to the code-generation agents. Rather than treating these utilities as isolated tools, the QA Coder synthesizes a programmatic execution plan, strictly enforcing geometric prerequisite chains. The LLM is abstracted away from continuous-space physics; its sole responsibility is topological routing and dependency orchestration. For instance, evaluating an allocentric directional relation mandates a strict order of operations: the pipeline must first invoke foundational APIs like get_object_xz_points to project raw 3D scene metadata into 2D coordinate footprints. Only upon completing this prerequisite projection can the higher-level relational API, is_spatial_relation_satisfied , perform deterministic interval intersections.
blocks.zh: 正如第1条正式规定的那样,我们向代码生成代理披露了空间API签名的结构化等级。 QA编码器没有将这些公用事业作为孤立的工具来对待,而是综合了一个方案执行计划,严格执行几何先决条件链. LLM从连续空间物理学中被抽象出来;它的唯一责任是地理学路由和依赖性管弦. 例如,评价一个偏心方向关系就要求严格的操作顺序:管道必须首先引用基础性API,如 get_object_xz_points,将原始的3D场景元数据投放到2D坐标脚印. 只有在完成这个先决条件的预测后,更高层次的关系API,即为_spatial_relation_satified,才能执行定相间隔相接.

blocks.en: Furthermore, the execution plan includes built-in geometric filters to maintain the high quality of the dataset. For instance, the system automatically routes calculated results through heuristic checks like is_angle_ambiguous . This step acts as a mandatory safety mechanism, actively discarding confusing or borderline spatial layouts before they can be generated into final QA pairs. By conceptualizing the LLM as a high-level coordinator that orchestrates these reliable mathematical functions, Exemplar2VQA significantly mitigates the risk of spatial hallucinations.
blocks.zh: 此外,执行计划还包括内置几何滤波器,以保持数据集的高质量. 例如,系统会自动通过huristic检查计算结果,例如Is_angle_矛盾。 这一步骤起到强制安全机制的作用,积极丢弃混淆或分界线的空间布局后再被生成出最终的QA对. 通过将LLM概念化为协调这些可靠的数学功能的高级协调员,Exemplar2VQA可以显著地减轻空间幻觉的风险.

blocks.en: Implementation Details. For evaluations on MMSI-Bench [ 27 ] , we synthesized approximately 6K QA pairs mirroring the target format and fine-tuned Qwen2.5-VL-7B [ 17 ] using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) [ 51 ] and Supervised Fine-Tuning (Full SFT) [ 52 , 53 ] . For VSI-Bench [ 26 ] , we generated roughly 10K QA pairs and applied full-parameter SFT on Qwen2.5-VL-3B [ 17 ] . To ensure balanced learning, we programmatically maintained a nearly uniform distribution across all spatial question types within these synthesized training datasets (see Appendix A.4 for detailed). Furthermore, to guarantee the reliability of the training data, a subset of the synthesized QA pairs underwent manual spot-checking prior to fine-tuning. We deliberately capped the dataset generation at these scales (6K and 10K) to conserve computational resources, as preliminary training revealed that this relatively small amount of high-quality data is already sufficient to yield substantial performance gains. In practice, the Exemplar2VQA pipeline is structurally capable of generating an infinite number of QA pairs, bounded only by the diversity of the simulated 3D rooms. Exemplar2VQA can access additional rooms via ProcTHOR [ 35 ] or Holodeck [ 36 ] (see Appendix A.2 for details). For all zero-shot evaluations on SpaCE-10 [ 45 ] and ViewSpatial-Bench [ 24 ] , we consistently deployed the Qwen2.5-VL-7B model fine-tuned solely on the MMSI-Bench synthetic data. It is imperative to note that throughout all experiments, we made absolutely no modifications to the underlying model architectures. To ensure a strictly fair comparison, all baseline models fine-tuned on other existing spatial datasets were trained using the exact same hyperparameters and optimization configurations as those applied to our Exemplar2VQA-generated data. We provide comprehensive implementation details in Appendix A.1 .
blocks.zh: 执行细节。 对于MMSI-Bench [27] 的评价,我们合成了大约6K QA对子,反射出目标格式,并用Low-Rank (LORA) [51] 和 Supervised Fine-Tuning (Full SFT) [52,53]. 对于VSI-Bench [26],我们生成了大约10K QA对子,并在Quen2.5-VL-3B上应用了全参数SFT [17]. 为确保平衡学习,我们从方案上在这些综合培训数据集中保持了在所有空间问题类型上的几乎统一分布(详见附录A.4)。 此外,为了保证培训数据的可靠性,在微调之前,对一组综合的质量保证对子进行了人工抽查。 我们故意限制这些比例尺(6K和10K)的数据集生成,以节省计算资源,因为初步培训表明,这种相对较少的高质量数据已经足以产生实质性的业绩收益。 在实际操作中,Exemplar2VQA管线在结构上能够产生出无限数量的QA对,仅以模拟的3D室的多样性为界. Exemplar2VQA可以通过ProcTHOR[35]或Holodeck[36]进入额外的房间(详情见附录A.2). 对于SpACE-10 [45] 和 ViewSpatial-Bench [24] 上的所有零镜头评价,我们一直将Quen2.5-VL-7B模型的微调完全部署在MSI-Bench合成数据上. 必须指出,在所有实验中,我们绝对没有修改基本模型结构。 为确保进行严格的公平比较,对所有对其他现有空间数据集进行微调的基线模型进行了培训,采用了与我们Exemplar2VQA生成的数据完全相同的超参数和优化配置。 我们在附录A.1中提供了全面执行的细节。

blocks.en: 4.2 Performance on Primary Spatial Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要空间基准的执行情况

blocks.en: Results on MMSI-Bench. Table 2 compares Exemplar2VQA against open-source MLLMs on the multi-image benchmark MMSI-Bench. Notably, tasks requiring abstract semantic shape projection ( Appr.* ) or dynamic temporal tracking ( Obj.* ) fall outside the static, coordinate-based generative scope of our current Exemplar2VQA pipeline. Therefore, we directly evaluated these two metrics under a zero-shot setting. Key observations include: (1) Ours achieves a new state-of-the-art overall score of 28.2%, surpassing massive models like InternVL2.5-38B. Ours also outperforms the same 7B base model fine-tuned on other existing spatial datasets. (2) Ours substantially improves upon its base Qwen2.5-VL-7B model, with striking gains in complex multi-view reasoning (e.g., +8.6% in Cam.-Cam.). (3) Even in the aforementioned zero-shot scenarios, Ours surprisingly boosts performance by 9.1% on Appr.* . (4) We observe a performance drop on Obj.* . Fine-tuning exclusively on static spatial configurations biases the model toward static reasoning, which inevitably interferes with the base model’s pre-trained temporal priors needed for dynamic tracking. (5) To verify that the gain does not stem from the LoRA adaptation itself, we additionally fine-tune the same 7B model with full SFT on the identical training set, which yields a comparable overall score.
blocks.zh: MMSI - Bench的成绩. 表2将Exemplar2VQA与多图像基准MMSI-Bench上的开源MLLMs进行比较. 值得注意的是,需要抽象语义外形投影(Appr.*)或动态时间跟踪(Obj.*)的任务不属于我们目前Exemplar2VQA管线的静态,以协调为基础的基因范围. 因此,我们直接在零镜头设定下评估这两个指标。 主要意见包括: (1)我国实现28.2%新高总分,超越了InternVL2.5-38B等大规模模式. 我们的战绩也优于同一7B基模型在其他现有空间数据集上的微调. (2) 我们的Qwen2.5-VL-7B模型大大改进了基础,在复杂的多视图推理(如Cam.-Cam的+8.6%)中取得了显著的进展。 (3) 即使在上述零射出场景中,Ours在Appr.*上也令人惊讶地提升了9.1%的性能. (4) 我们观察到Obj的性能下降。 完全根据静态空间布局进行精细调整,使模型偏向于静态推理,这不可避免地会干扰基模型在动态跟踪方面事先经过训练的时间前科。 (5)为了核实收益并非来自LORA自适应本身,我们还用完全的SFT对相同的7B型号进行微调,在同一套训练中得出可比的总分.

blocks.en: Results on VSI-Bench. We further evaluate Exemplar2VQA on the egocentric video benchmark VSI-Bench (Table 2 ). Under our straightforward prompt-based SFT approach, directly training models for continuous numerical outputs yields sub-optimal results [ 2 ] . Since our primary objective is to validate the effectiveness of Exemplar2VQA-generated data for spatial reasoning, we focus exclusively on the multiple-choice subset. Furthermore, tasks such as Route Planning ( Route Plan* ), fall outside the static, point-to-point generative scope of our current pipeline and are thus evaluated in a zero-shot setting. From these evaluations, we observe that: (1) Our 3B model achieves an impressive 42.9% overall, outperforming advanced proprietary models like GPT-4o and Gemini-1.5 Pro , as well as the 72B open-source LLaVA-Video. Crucially, Ours also decisively surpasses the same 3B base model fine-tuned on other existing spatial datasets. (2) Compared to its base Qwen2.5-VL-3B, Ours delivers a massive 7.6% absolute boost in overall accuracy, with exceptional enhancements in specific sub-tasks like Relative Direction. (3) Even in the zero-shot Route Plan* scenario, Ours yields a notable 6.2% improvement over the base model. Moreover, the benefit of our synthetic data is not limited to a single backbone: fine-tuning InternVL2-2B and InternVL2-8B on the same training set yields consistent gains (see Table A3 in Appendix), suggesting transferable supervision across model scales and architectures.
blocks.zh: 关于VSI-Bench的结果. 我们进一步评价以自我为中心的视频基准VSI-Bench(表2)的Exemplar2VQA。 根据我们简明易懂的即时SFT方法,持续数字产出的直接培训模式产生非最佳结果[2]。 由于我们的首要目标是验证Exemplar2VQA生成的数据的有效性,用于空间推理,因此我们只专注于多选择子集. 此外,诸如 " 路由规划 " ( " 路由规划* " )等任务不属于我们目前管道的静态、点对点基因范围,因此在零射入的环境下进行评估。 从这些评价中,我们观察到:(1) 我们的3B模型总体上实现了令人印象深刻的42.9%,优于GPT-4o和双子座1.5 Pro等先进专利模型,以及72B开源LLaVA-Video. 关键是, 我国还果断地超越了同一3B基础模型在其他现有空间数据集上的微调. (2)与它的基数Qwen2.5-VL-3B相比,"Ours"在整体准确度上提供了7.6%的巨大绝对提升,在"相对方向"等特定子任务中也有了特殊的增强. (3) 即使在零射出路线计划* 的情景中,我们的系统比基准模型有显著的6.2%。 此外,我们的合成数据的好处并不局限于单一的主干线:在同一培训组上对InternVL2-2B和InternVL2-8B进行微调,产生一致的收益(见附录表A3),建议跨模型规模和结构的可转移监督。

blocks.en: 4.3 Performance on Zero-Shot Generalization Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 4.3 零热通化基准的执行情况

blocks.en: Results on SpaCE-10. To assess zero-shot OOD generalization, we evaluate Exemplar2VQA on the SpaCE-10 benchmark (Table 4 ). Key observations include: (1) Ours achieves an 8.9% absolute overall improvement over the base Qwen2.5-VL-7B. Crucially, it also secures the highest overall zero-shot performance by outperforming the same base model fine-tuned on other spatial datasets. (2) Exceptional gains in physics- and geometry-heavy tasks, notably Size Assessment (+18.2%) and Function Reasoning (+16.1%). (3) The performance drop in Scene Quantification ( Scene Quant. ) is an expected trade-off. This task requires abstract semantic grouping of "functional zones", causing slight negative transfer since Ours focuses strictly on instance-level bounding-box geometry. Nevertheless, overwhelming improvements in 7 out of 8 categories validate our approach.
blocks.zh: SpaCE-10的结果. 为了评估零发OOD通化,我们用SpaCE-10基准评价Exemplar2VQA(表4)。 主要意见包括: (1) 我们的绝对总的改进率比Quen2.5-VL-7B达到8.9%。 关键是,它还通过在其他空间数据集上对同一基模型进行微调,以优于该模型,确保了最高的整体零发性能. (2) 在物理和几何重度任务方面取得的特殊进展,特别是规模评估(+18.2%)和函数理性(+16.1%)。 (3)场景分量(Scene Quant.)的性能下降是预期的取舍. 这项任务需要抽象地将"功能区"进行语义分组,引起轻微的负转移,因为Ours严格注重实例级的边框几何. 然而,在8个类别中,有7个类别有了极大的改进,这证实了我们的做法。

blocks.en: Results on ViewSpatial-Bench. Extending our zero-shot OOD evaluation to ViewSpatial-Bench (Table 4 ), we observe: (1) Despite fine-tuning exclusively on synthetic indoor environments, ours delivers an 8.5% overall boost on this diverse benchmark featuring complex mixed and outdoor scenes. Crucially, ours also significantly outperforms the same base model fine-tuned on other spatial datasets. (2) The most striking enhancement occurs in Object View Orientation from the human perspective ( Obj. Ori. (Per) ), surging by 23.5% absolute and easily eclipsing the other spatial baselines. (3) Consistent gains in other challenging person-centric tasks, such as Scene Simulation Relative Direction (+10.7%) and Person-perspective Relative Direction (+6.0%).

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Study on Multi-Agent Architectures and Generator Capacity
blocks.zh: 4.4 关于多代理建筑和发电机能力的研究

blocks.en: To validate the necessity of our decoupled multi-agent framework, we conduct an ablation study on the agent topology. We sample 100 seed examples and evaluate the generation success rate for both the QA Generation Track and the Camera Trajectory Track. Importantly, “success” strictly refers to the executed code producing mathematically and semantically correct final outputs. A comprehensive analysis of the error types is detailed in Section A.5 . As presented in Table 5 , we progressively merge the specialized agent roles.
blocks.zh: 为了验证我们脱钩的多剂框架的必要性,我们开展了一项关于剂地貌的研究。 我们抽取了100个种子实例,并评价了QA生成轨迹和相机轨迹的生成成功率。 重要的是, " 成功 " 严格是指用数学和模拟方法生成正确最终产出的已执行代码。 A.5节详细分析了错误类型。 如表5所示,我们逐步合并了专门机构的作用。

blocks.en: Key observations include: (1) The failure of monolithic models. When all roles are collapsed into a single agent, the accuracy plummets to 34.0% for QA generation and 60.0% for camera navigation. This empirically confirms that forcing a single LLM to simultaneously interpret semantics, write deterministic geometric code, and resolve physics-based simulator bugs leads to severe cognitive overload. (2) The power of isolating semantic planning. Splitting the pipeline into 2 agents yields massive absolute surges: +38.0% in QA generation and +14.0% in camera tracking. (3) The necessity of decoupled debugging. Progressively separating the bug diagnosis from the code patching process steadily pushes performance to its peak (92.0% and 84.0%).
blocks.zh: 主要意见包括: (1)单体模型的失败. 当所有角色被倒塌成单一的代理时,精度会下降至QA生成的34.0%和相机导航的60.0%. 这种经验性地证实,强迫单个LLM同时解释语义,写出定理几何码,并解决以物理为基础的模拟器bug导致严重的认知超载. (2)孤立语义规划的力量. 将输油管分出为2个剂,会产生巨大的绝对猛增:QA生成时为+38.0%,相机跟踪时为+14.0%. (3)脱钩调试的必要性. 逐步将错误诊断与代码补丁过程相分离,稳步将性能推向顶峰(92.0%和84.0%).

blocks.en: Beyond topology, we further examine the impact of generator capacity. Since Qwen3-Coder-30B is already the smallest model in the Qwen3-Coder family, we adopt Qwen3.5-9B as a smaller generator alternative under the same 4-agent pipeline. This replacement drops QA generation from 92.0% to 48.0% and camera trajectory from 84.0% to 56.0%, suggesting that generator capacity is crucial for reliably synthesizing executable scripts and valid camera trajectories.
blocks.zh: 除了地貌外,我们进一步审查发电机容量的影响。 自兹 Qune3-Coder-30B已经是Qune3-Coder家族中最小的型号,我们采用Qune3.5-9B作为同为4剂管下更小的发电机替代品. 这种替换使QA生成率从92.0%降至48.0%,相机轨迹从84.0%降至56.0%,这表明发电机容量对于可靠地合成可执行脚本和有效相机轨迹至关重要.

blocks.en: 4.5 Comparison with Direct LLM Annotation
blocks.zh: 4.5 与直接LLM注释的比较

blocks.en: A natural alternative to our code-based generation is to directly employ a powerful VLM to annotate QA pairs. To investigate this, we use Gemini3.5-Flash to directly label 10K synthetic training examples for the multiple-choice subset of VSI-Bench, and fine-tune the same Qwen2.5-VL-3B base model on this annotated data under identical training configurations. As shown in Table 6 , direct LLM annotation is insufficient for this setting: it underperforms Exemplar2VQA by a large margin and even degrades performance relative to the base model on average, with a particularly severe drop on Appr. Order. We attribute this to the fact that multi-view spatial QA demands not only locally plausible answer prediction, but also cross-view consistency, de-duplication, and stable context tracking, which cannot be guaranteed by direct LLM/VLM labeling.
blocks.zh: 我们基于代码的一代的自然替代品是,直接使用强大的VLM来注释QA对. 为了调查这一点,我们使用双子座3.5-Flash直接给VSI-Bench的多选择子集的10K合成训练实例贴上标签,并在相同的训练配置下,将本注解数据上相同的Quen2.5-VL-3B基础模型进行微调. 如表6所示,直接的LLM注释对于这个设置来说是不够的:它表现不佳的Exemplar2VQA大相径庭,甚至平均比起基准模型降低性能,Appr. Order的下降尤其严重. 我们将此归因于一个事实,即多视图空间QA不仅需要本地可信的答案预测,而且需要交叉视图的一致性,去重复性,以及稳定的上下文跟踪,这不能通过直接LLM/VLM标签来保证.

blocks.en: 4.6 Remarks on Efficiency
blocks.zh: 4.6 关于效率的评论

blocks.en: Operating across two GPUs, Exemplar2VQA maintains high efficiency for large-scale data synthesis. For given abstract spatial task, the code synthesis phase requires an average overhead: the Camera Trajectory Track averages only 3 minutes to autonomously plan, code, and resolve physics-based bugs in AI2-THOR, while the QA Generation Track averages only 2 minutes to synthesize the deterministic mathematical scripts. Once these reusable scripts are generated, the subsequent data execution scales linearly and rapidly with the number of simulated scenes without requiring further LLM intervention. A comprehensive throughput analysis is provided in Appendix A.6 .
blocks.zh: 运行于两个GPU之间,Exemplar2VQA为大规模数据合成保持了高效率. 对于给定的抽象空间任务,代码合成相需要平均高空:相机轨迹轨迹平均只有3分钟,才能在AI2-THOR中自主地计划,代码并解决基于物理的bug;而QA生成轨迹平均只有2分钟来合成决定数学脚本. 这些可重复使用的脚本被生成后,随后的数据执行会随着模拟场景的数量而线性地和快地进行分级,而不需要进一步的LLM干预. 附录A.6提供了综合吞吐量分析。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we present Exemplar2VQA, a scalable exemplar-driven VQA generation framework that mitigates MLLMs’ spatial reasoning limitations via deterministic mathematical execution. By leveraging geometric utilities and physics-constrained simulator feedback, Exemplar2VQA autonomously scales query exemplars into massive, high-fidelity spatial QA datasets. Experiments on MMSI-Bench and VSI-Bench demonstrate substantial performance gains over the base models, notably outperforming proprietary models like GPT-4o specifically on VSI-Bench. Furthermore, zero-shot evaluations on ViewSpatial-Bench and SpaCE-10 validate that spatial priors learned exclusively from synthetic indoor data effectively generalize to complex, unseen outdoor environments, offering a scalable approach to bridge the sim-to-real gap in Embodied AI.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出了Exemplar2VQA,这是一个可扩展的由VQA驱动的生成框架,通过确定数学执行来缓解MLLMs的空间推理限制. 通过利用几何公用和物理学所约束的模拟器反馈,Exemplar2VQA自主地将查询实例分解为大规模高纯度空间QA数据集. 有关MSI-Bench和VSI-Bench的实验显示,它们比基本模型有相当大的性能收益,特别是特别在VSI-Bench上的GPT-4o等业绩优于专有模型。 此外,对VideoSpatial-Bench和Space-10的零镜头评价证实,空间前科完全从合成室内数据中吸取,有效地概括到复杂而隐蔽的室外环境,提供了一种可扩展的方法来弥补Embody AI中的模拟-实际差距。

blocks.en: A.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: A.1 执行细节

blocks.en: A.1.1 Training Hyperparameters
blocks.zh: A.1.1 训练超参数

blocks.en: In this section, we detail the specific training configurations used to fine-tune our models on the Exemplar2VQA-generated synthetic datasets. Both models were trained utilizing the swift framework distributed. DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 optimization was employed in both setups to manage memory efficiency. Furthermore, to enhance instruction fine-tuning robustness, we applied NEFTune (Noise Embeddings for Fine-Tuning) with a noise alpha of 5 across all experiments. All inference evaluations were conducted on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU, while all fine-tuning procedures were distributed across four NVIDIA H200 GPUs. The dual-track Exemplar2VQA data generation pipelines were executed across two NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPUs.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们详细介绍了用于在Exemplar2VQA生成的合成数据集上微调我们的模型的具体训练配置. 这两个模式都利用分发的快速框架进行了培训。 两个设置都采用了DeepSpeed ZeRO-2优化,以管理内存效率. 此外,为了提高教学的精细性能,我们在所有实验中都应用了有5个噪声的NEFTune(噪音嵌入法). 所有推论评价都是对一个单一的NVIDIA H200 GPU进行的,而所有微调程序都分布在四个NVIDIA H200 GPU中. 双轨Exemplar2VQA数据生成管被执行到两个NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU.

blocks.en: Qwen2.5-VL-3B (VSI-Bench). For the downstream VSI-Bench evaluation, we performed SFT on the Qwen2.5-VL-3B base model. The training was conducted over 3 epochs with a learning rate of 1e-5, utilizing a cosine learning rate scheduler with a warmup ratio of 0.05. We applied a weight decay of 0.01. The per-device train batch size was set to 4 with 2 gradient accumulation steps, resulting in a global effective batch size of 32 across the four GPUs.
blocks.zh: Quen2.5-VL-3B (VSI-Bench) (英语). 对于下游VSI-Bench评价,我们在Quen2.5-VL-3B基型上进行了SFT. 培训是在3个学期进行的,学习率为1e-5,使用同位素学习率计时器,热能比为0.05。 我们做了0.01的体重衰减 每节编组列车的批量尺寸被设定为4个,并有2个梯度积分步骤,导致全球有效批量尺寸为32个,跨越了4个GPU.

blocks.en: Qwen2.5-VL-7B (MMSI-Bench). For the MMSI-Bench evaluation, we utilized LoRA to fine-tune the Qwen2.5-VL-7B base model using bfloat16 (bf16) precision. The LoRA rank ( r r ) was set to 16 with a LoRA alpha of 32. Similar to the 3B model, training spanned 3 epochs, but with a higher learning rate of 1e-4. We employed a cosine learning rate scheduler, a warmup ratio of 0.05, and a weight decay of 0.01. The per-device train batch size was configured to 2 with 4 gradient accumulation steps, also yielding a global effective batch size of 32. To accommodate the specific visual demands of the multi-image dataset, we constrained the maximum image resolution to 1,003,520 pixels.
blocks.zh: Quen2.5-VL-7B (MMSI-Bench) (英语). 对于MMSI-Bench评价,我们利用LORA,使用bfloat16(bf16)精度来微调Quen2.5-VL-7B基模型. LORA级(r r r)被设定为16级,而LORAα为32级. 与3B模式相类似,培训跨越了3个纪元,但高等教育率为1e-4. 我们使用了余弦学习速度计,热能比为0.05,体重衰减为0.01。 每节编组列车的批量尺寸被配置为2个,并有4个梯度积分阶梯,也产生了全球有效批量大小为32个. 为了适应多图像数据集的具体视觉需求,我们把最大图像分辨率限制在1,003,520像素.

blocks.en: A.1.2 Data Formatting and Training Prompts

blocks.en: To ensure our models learn to strictly adhere to the diverse protocols of the target benchmarks during inference, we distinctively formatted our SFT training datasets based on the input modality requirements of each task.
blocks.zh: 为了确保我们的模型在推论中学会严格遵守目标基准的各种协议,我们根据每项任务的输入模式要求,对我们的SFT培训数据集进行了独特的格式化。

blocks.en: VSI-Bench. To accurately align our synthetic training data with the evaluation format of VSI-Bench, which fundamentally assesses visual-spatial intelligence from egocentric videos, we converted the multi-view spatial images generated by Exemplar2VQA into continuous rotation videos. Consequently, the SFT dataset was formatted into a standard conversational structure containing a single video input sequence. The training instruction explicitly guides the model to output the deterministic spatial answer along with the text content, enclosed within precise XML-style tags.
blocks.zh: VSI-奔驰. 为了精确地将我们的合成训练数据与VSI-Bench的评价格式相配合,后者从根本上评估了以自我为中心的视频的视觉-空间智能,我们把Exemplar2VQA生成的多视图空间图像转换为连续自转视频. 因此,SFT数据集被格式化为包含单一视频输入序列的标准对话结构. 训练指示明确指导模型输出确定性的空间答案以及文本内容,并附在精确的XML式标记中。

blocks.en: A.2 Infinite Generation via ProcTHOR and Holodeck
blocks.zh: A.2 通过ProcTHOR和Holodeck实现无限世代

blocks.en: While our experiments deliberately capped the generated training datasets at 6K and 10K pairs to conserve computational resources, the Exemplar2VQA framework is fundamentally designed as a highly scalable engine. Because Exemplar2VQA relies entirely on deterministic programmatic execution interacting with simulator scene metadata, its generation capacity is bottlenecked solely by the diversity and quantity of available 3D simulated environments. To overcome the limitations of a fixed set of manually crafted scenes, Exemplar2VQA can seamlessly integrate with advanced environment generation platforms such as ProcTHOR [ 35 ] and Holodeck [ 36 ] , effectively unlocking an "infinite generation" paradigm.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的实验故意将生成的训练数据集封顶到6K和10K对,以节约计算资源,但Exemplar2VQA框架从根本上被设计为高度可扩展的引擎. 由于Exemplar2VQA完全依赖于与模拟场景元数据相互作用的决定性程序执行,其生成能力完全被现有的3D模拟环境的多样性和数量所束缚. 为了克服一组固定的手工制作的场景的局限性,Exemplar2VQA可以无缝地与ProcTHOR [35]和Holodeck [36]等先进的环境生成平台相融合,有效解开了"无限生成"的范式.

blocks.en: Scaling with ProcTHOR. ProcTHOR serves as a massive repository of procedurally generated, ready-to-use 3D environments. It provides access to tens of thousands of diverse, fully interactive houses and floorplans. Exemplar2VQA can autonomously iterate through this extensive database, continuously extracting fresh scene metadata (e.g., novel object configurations, varying room layouts, and diverse occlusions) without requiring any manual curation. This ensures that the generated spatial question-answer pairs maintain high domain diversity and rarely suffer from geometric repetition.
blocks.zh: 与 ProcTHOR 缩放 。 ProcTHOR是大量程序生成,即时使用3D环境的存储器. 它提供数以万计的多样化、充分互动的房屋和地板。 Exemplar2VQA可以自主地通过这个广泛的数据库进行去除,不断取出新鲜的场景元数据(如新颖对象配置,不同房间布局,以及多样化的占卜)而无需任何人工解析. 这确保所生成的空间问答对保持了高域多样性,并很少出现几何重复.

blocks.en: Customized Generation via Holodeck. For targeted domain adaptation or handling highly specific spatial scenarios, Exemplar2VQA leverages Holodeck for dynamic, language-guided environment generation. Holodeck allows the system to synthesize entirely new rooms within the AI2-THOR simulator simply by providing a natural language room definition or prompt (e.g., "A co-working space featuring a large communal desk and multiple rolling chairs arranged in a grid pattern at the room’s center." or "A media room featuring a large recliner and a low TV stand arranged in a linear orientation at the room’s center."). Once the prompt is processed, Holodeck autonomously populates the layout and outputs the precise scene metadata.
blocks.zh: 通过Holodeck定制生成. 对于目标域适应或处理高度具体的空间情景,Exemplar2VQA将Holodeck用于动态的,语言引导的环境生成. Holodeck允许系统在AI2-THOR模拟器内完全合成新的房间,只需提供自然语言室定义或即时(例如"一个以一个大型公用办公桌和多张滚动椅为主的共事空间,在室内中心按网格排列"或"一个以一个大型对流器和低电视台为主的媒体室,在室内中心按线性取向排列"). 一旦该提示被处理,霍洛德克会自主地填充布局并输出精确的场景元数据.

blocks.en: By utilizing ProcTHOR for broad, large-scale data expansion and Holodeck for customized, prompt-driven scene creation, Exemplar2VQA establishes a virtually unlimited, continuously expanding sandbox. This synergy guarantees an endless supply of high-fidelity spatial configurations.
blocks.zh: Exemplar2VQA通过利用ProcTHOR进行大范围的数据扩展和Holodeck进行定制的,即时驱动的场景创建,建立了一个几乎无限的,不断扩展的沙盒. 这种协同作用保证了高纯度空间配置的无尽供给.

blocks.en: A.3 Extended Experiments: Template Adaptation and QA Visualizations
blocks.zh: A.3 扩展实验:模板适应和质量保证可视化

blocks.en: In this section, we present extended experimental results to further demonstrate the exceptional versatility and OOD generalization of the Exemplar2VQA framework. As discussed in the main text, Exemplar2VQA is not confined to a predefined set of tasks; rather, it can seamlessly adapt static object-centric spatial query templates from diverse downstream benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们提出扩大的实验结果,以进一步证明Exemplar2VQA框架的特殊多功能性和OOD通化. 如正文所讨论,Exemplar2VQA并不局限于预设的一组任务;相反,它可以从不同的下游基准来无缝地调整静态以物体为中心的空间查询模板.

blocks.en: A.3.1 Evaluation Results on OSR-Bench
blocks.zh: A.3.1 关于业务社会责任的评价结果

blocks.en: Omni-Spatial-Reasoning (OSR) Benchmarks [ 54 ] . To further investigate spatial intelligence in 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} panoramic environments, we extend our evaluation to OSR-Bench. OSR-Bench comprises over 153,000 diverse Question-Answer (QA) pairs.
blocks.zh: Omni-Spatial-Reasoning(OSR)基准 [54]. 为了进一步调查360X360Circ]全景环境中的空间情报,我们把评价扩展到了OSR-Bench. OSR-Bench包括153,000多对不同的问答(QA)对.

blocks.en: Implementation Details. For the extended evaluation on OSR-Bench, we synthesized approximately 6K QA pairs utilizing the Exemplar2VQA framework, meticulously adhering to the diverse spatial query templates established by the benchmark (including object counting, relative distance, and relative direction, as visualized in Figure A1 ). We then fine-tuned the Qwen2.5-VL-7B model exclusively on this newly synthesized dataset. Consistent with our approach for MMSI-Bench, the fine-tuning was performed using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and distributed across four NVIDIA H200 GPUs. The specific training hyperparameters were kept strictly identical to those used for the MMSI-Bench evaluations to ensure comparative consistency. Comprehensive details regarding these training hyperparameters are provided in Appendix A.1 .
blocks.zh: 执行细节。 关于对OSR-Bench的扩展评价,我们利用Exemplar2VQA框架合成了大约6K个QA对,仔细地遵守了基准确定的多种空间查询模板(包括物体计数、相对距离和相对方向,如图A1所示)。 然后我们专门在这个新合成的数据集上微调了Quen2.5-VL-7B模型. 与我们对MMSI-Bench的做法一致,微调是使用Low-Rank适应(LORA)进行的,并分布在四个NVIDIA H200 GPU中. 具体培训超参数与管理、军事和安保部-本奇评价所用的参数严格相同,以确保相对一致性。 关于这些训练超参数的全面详情见附录A.1。

blocks.en: Figure A1: Visual examples of diversified spatial QA pairs and corresponding 3D scenes programmatically generated by the Exemplar2VQA framework. This visualization demonstrates the framework’s versatility in adapting and scaling diverse query templates sourced from the OSR-Bench for Object Counting , Relative Distance , and Relative Direction across different generated environments to create massive and high-fidelity spatial reasoning datasets.
blocks.zh: 图A1:由Exemplar2VQA框架在程序上生成的多元空间QA对和相应3D场景的可视取向实例. 这种可视化显示了框架在调整和缩放来自OSR-Bench的用于对象计数、相对距离和不同生成环境的相对方向的各种查询模板方面的多功能性,以创建大规模和高真实性的空间推理数据集。

blocks.en: Table A1: Performance comparison on the OSR-Bench dataset . The best results are shown in bold , and the second-best are underlined . A superscript plus sign ( + ) indicates a performance improvement over the base Qwen2.5-VL-7B model.
blocks.zh: 表A1: OSR-Bench数据集的业绩比较 最佳结果以粗体表示, 一个上标加号(+)表示比起基座的Quen2.5-VL-7B型号的性能改进.

blocks.en: Results on OSR-Bench. Table A1 compares Exemplar2VQA against powerful baseline MLLMs on the OSR-Bench dataset. Crucially, the training data synthesized by Exemplar2VQA consisted merely of four discrete, sparse surround-view images per scene, rather than the continuous equirectangular 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} panoramas natively evaluated in OSR-Bench. Key observations include: (1) Despite this distinct visual domain gap, Exemplar2VQA (Ours, LoRA-7B) achieves an impressive overall average of 36.5%, successfully outperforming significantly larger baseline models such as Qwen2.5-VL-72B (33.5%) and LLaVA-v1.5-13B (31.6%). Notably, it establishes top performance in both Object Count (59.0%) and Relative Distance (41.1%). (2) Exemplar2VQA delivers a massive 8.2% absolute boost in overall accuracy compared to its base Qwen2.5-VL-7B model (from 28.3% to 36.5%), with consistent enhancements across all sub-tasks, including a striking +12.7% increase in Object Count and +10.0% in Relative Distance.
blocks.zh: OSR - Bench的结果。 表A1比较了OSR-Bench数据集上强大的基线MLLMs的Exemplar2VQA. 关键是,Exemplar2VQA合成的训练数据仅由每个场景四个离散,零星的环景图像组成,而不是连续的平方360-360-Circ}全景在OSR-Bench进行本土评价. 主要意见包括: (1) 尽管视觉领域存在这一明显差距,Exemplar2VQA(我们的,LORA-7B)的总平均成就令人印象深刻,达到36.5%,成功超过Quen2.5-VL-72B(33.5%)和LLaVA-v1.5-13B(31.6%)等显著较大的基线模型。 值得注意的是,它在对象计数(59.0%)和相对距离(41.1%)中确立了最高性能。 (2)Exemplar2VQA与它的Qwen2.5-VL-7B基型相比,在整体精度上产生巨大的8.2%的绝对提升(从28.3%到36.5%),在所有子任务上都有一致的增强,包括对象计数的惊人+12.7%和相对距离的+1.0.0%.

blocks.en: While the Exemplar2VQA rendering pipeline is structurally capable of stitching and projecting continuous 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} panoramic images for training—which would naturally eliminate this modality gap and likely drive performance even higher—we deliberately omitted this step. Because our primary objective is to validate the fundamental utility and geometric accuracy of the Exemplar2VQA pipeline’s automated QA generation, rather than merely engineering a state-of-the-art model tailored to a specific image format, the current substantial performance gains under this challenging zero-shot view-transfer setting are already sufficient to prove our premise.

blocks.en: A.3.2 Evaluation Results on Spatial-MM Datasets
blocks.zh: A.3.2 空间-MM数据集评价结果

blocks.en: Spatial-MM Datasets [ 56 ] . To evaluate spatial reasoning capabilities in everyday environments, we utilize Spatial-MM, an additional real-world life-scene datasets. For our experiments, we focus exclusively on its Spatial-Obj subset. Spatial-Obj comprises 2,000 multiple-choice questions that assess spatial relationships involving one or two objects within an image. The dataset categorizes these spatial configurations into distinct visual patterns, including object localization, orientation and direction, viewpoints, and positional and relational context. Furthermore, the questions are structured to evaluate spatial relationships from both the standard camera perspective and the human perspective within the image.
blocks.zh: 空间-MM数据集 [56]. 为了评估日常环境中的空间推理能力,我们使用空间-MM,这是另一个真实世界的生命空间数据集。 对于我们的实验, 我们专注于它的空间-Obj子集。 Space-Obj包含2,000个多选择问题,评估一个图像内涉及一到两个物体的空间关系. 数据集将这些空间配置分为不同的视觉模式,包括物体定位,取向和方向,观点,位置和关系上下文等. 此外,这些问题的结构是为了从标准相机角度和图像中的人的角度评价空间关系。

blocks.en: Implementation Details. For the evaluation on the Spatial-MM benchmark, we adopted a strictly zero-shot setting, consistent with our methodology for the SpaCE-10 and ViewSpatial-Bench evaluations. Specifically, we deployed the Qwen2.5-VL-7B model that was fine-tuned exclusively on the synthetic data generated for MMSI-Bench. No additional, dataset-specific training or parameter updates were performed using the Spatial-MM data. This rigorous zero-shot setup allows us to genuinely assess the cross-dataset transferability of the spatial priors learned from the Exemplar2VQA pipeline. Comprehensive implementation details regarding the acquisition of this deployed model, including the specific training hyperparameters, are detailed in Appendix A.1 .
blocks.zh: 执行细节。 关于空间-MM基准评价,我们采用了完全零发设定,这符合我们对SpaCE-10和ViewSpatial-Bench评价的方法。 具体地说,我们采用了Quen2.5-VL-7B模型,该模型专门根据MMSI-Bench生成的合成数据进行了微调. 没有利用空间-MM数据进行其他特定数据集培训或参数更新。 这种严格的零发式设置使我们能够真正地评估从Exemplar2VQA管道中吸取的空间前传的跨数据集可转移性. 附录A.1详细说明了购置这一已部署模型的全面实施细节,包括具体的训练超参数。

Key observations include: (1) Despite this challenging sim-to-real domain gap, Exemplar2VQA (Ours, LoRA-7B) consistently outperforms the Qwen2.5-VL-7B base model across all evaluated configurations. The ability of Exemplar2VQA to squeeze out further improvements on unseen, complex real-world photographs—relying strictly on geometric priors learned from synthetic multi-view data—confirms that our automated generation framework injects robust, universally transferable spatial intelligence rather than simply overfitting to the synthetic domain.

blocks.en: A.4 Arbitrary Control and Analysis of QA Category Distributions
blocks.zh: A.4 任意控制和分析质量保证类别

blocks.en: The Bottleneck of Existing Benchmarks. While recent benchmarks have significantly advanced the evaluation of spatial intelligence in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), relying on human-annotated datasets inevitably introduces static and imbalanced category distributions. Due to the inherent preferences of human annotators and the varying difficulty of question formulation, conventional datasets often exhibit a heavy bias towards straightforward spatial queries (e.g., basic relative direction or object recognition). When MLLMs are fine-tuned on such skewed distributions, they tend to develop strong preference biases, resulting in degraded generalization performance when confronted with rare or out-of-distribution spatial configurations.
blocks.zh: 现有基准的Bottleneck。 虽然最近的基准大大地推动了对多式大语言模型(MLLMs)空间智能的评估,但依靠人附加说明的数据集不可避免地引入了静态和不平衡的类别分布. 由于人类注释者的固有偏好和问题表述的不同难度,常规数据集往往表现出对直截了当的空间查询(如基本相对方向或物体识别)的强烈偏向. 当MLLMs对这种扭曲的分布进行微调时,它们往往会形成强烈的偏好偏好,在遇到稀有或分散的空间配置时,导致普遍化性能退化.

blocks.en: Exemplar2VQA’s Arbitrary Control Paradigm. To overcome this critical bottleneck, Exemplar2VQA fundamentally shifts the paradigm from static dataset curation to dynamic, programmable data synthesis. Because Exemplar2VQA relies on a deterministic multi-agent coding framework interacting with scene metadata, it functions as an autonomous generation engine rather than a fixed dataset. Driven by a theoretically infinite generation capacity—bounded only by the diversity and quantity of available 3D simulated scenes (as detailed in Appendix A.2 via integrations with ProcTHOR and Holodeck)—Exemplar2VQA allows researchers to programmatically define the exact synthesis ratios across any spatial query categories.
blocks.zh: Exemplar2VQA的任意控制范式. 为了克服这个关键的瓶颈,Exemplar2VQA从根本上将范式从静态数据集解析转变为动态,可编程的数据合成. 由于Exemplar2VQA依赖于一个与场景元数据交互的定型多代理编码框架,它作为自主生成引擎而非固定数据集发挥作用. 由理论上无限的生成能力所驱动——这种能力仅受现有3D模拟场景的多样性和数量的限制(如附录A.2通过与ProcTHOR和Holodeck的结合所详述)——Exemplar2VQA允许研究人员在方案上确定任何空间查询类别的确切合成比率。

blocks.en: Distribution Comparison and Visualization. As illustrated in Figure A2 (Top), existing leading benchmarks (such as ViewSpatial-Bench, MMSI-Bench, and VSI-Bench) are constrained by rigid QA category proportions, with certain basic spatial categories dominating the visual evaluations. In stark contrast, the bottom panel of Figure A2 conceptually visualizes Exemplar2VQA’s arbitrary control mechanism through an intuitive “slider” metaphor. Mechanistically, rather than relying on complex data augmentation or rebalancing algorithms, Exemplar2VQA achieves this flexibility through sheer scale. Because the pipeline synthesizes an overwhelmingly large and diverse pool of candidate QA pairs across thousands of simulated rooms, deriving a dataset with any exact, customized category distribution is as straightforward as performing targeted random sampling from this massive pool. This effectively amplifies the presence of scarce spatial queries, effortlessly circumventing the data imbalance bottleneck.
blocks.zh: 分布比较与可视化. 如图A2(Top)所示,现有的主要基准(如ViewSpatial-Bench、MMSI-Bench和VSI-Bench)受到严格的质量保证类别比例的限制,某些基本空间类别主导了视觉评价。 与此形成鲜明对比的是,图A2的下部面板在概念上通过直观的"滑坡"比喻将Exemplar2VQA的任意控制机制可视化. 在机械上,Exemplar2VQA不是依靠复杂的数据增强或再平衡算法,而是通过纯粹的尺度来实现这种灵活性. 由于输油管在上千个模拟房间合成了数量庞大、种类繁多的候选质量评估组合,生成一个包含任何精确、定制类别分布的数据集,与从这个庞大组合中进行有针对性的随机抽样一样简单。 这有效地扩大了稀缺空间查询的存在,不遗余力地规避了数据不平衡的瓶颈.

blocks.en: Implications for MLLM Spatial Intelligence. This unprecedented flexibility offers profound implications for advancing the 3D spatial reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs):
blocks.zh: 对MLLM空间情报的影响。 这种史无前例的灵活性对提高多式联运大语言模型的三维空间推理能力产生了深远的影响:

blocks.en: 1. Targeted Remediation for Spatial Hallucinations: When diagnostic benchmarks reveal that an MLLM struggles with specific geometric concepts (e.g., exhibiting severe spatial hallucinations regarding 3D occlusion, allocentric viewpoints, or relative depth ordering), researchers are no longer bound by the prohibitive costs of manual data collection. Exemplar2VQA can instantly synthesize targeted diagnostic datasets, focused supervised fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 空间幻觉定向补救: 当诊断基准显示,MLLM与具体的几何概念相冲突(例如,在3D隔离、偏心观点或相对深度排序方面表现出了严重的空间幻觉),研究人员就不再受到人工数据收集高昂成本的约束。 Exemplar2VQA可以即时合成有针对性的诊断数据集,有重点地监督微调.

blocks.en: 2. Curriculum Learning for 3D Cognition: Exemplar2VQA’s programmable distribution naturally facilitates curriculum learning for spatial intelligence. Model training pipelines can be dynamically structured to mimic progressive cognitive development—initiating with a distribution rich in basic instance recognition and simple egocentric relative directions, before smoothly transitioning into highly complex, allocentric 3D reasoning and multi-view geometric transformations. This progressive, data-driven approach yields a much more robust and compositionally sound spatial representation within the MLLM.
blocks.zh: 2. 3D认知课程学习:Exemplar2VQA的可编程分布自然有利于空间智能课程学习。 示范培训管道可以动态地进行结构化,以模仿逐步的认知发展——在顺利过渡到高度复杂、多相向的3D推理和多相相向的几何转换之前,启动一个具有丰富基本实例识别和简单自我中心相对方向的分布。 这种由数据驱动的渐进式方法,在MLLM中产生了更为有力和结构合理的空间代表。

blocks.en: A.5 Comprehensive Error Analysis
blocks.zh: A.5 综合错误分析

blocks.en: To gain deeper insights into the operational bottlenecks of the Exemplar2VQA pipeline, we conduct a comprehensive failure mode analysis. We categorize the types of errors encountered during the generation process and compare their distribution between the monolithic (1 Agent) and multi-agent (4 Agents) configurations. It is crucial to note that, as established in Section 4.4 , the absolute number of failures drops significantly under the multi-agent framework; therefore, the following analysis examines the proportion of remaining failure modes.
blocks.zh: 为了更深入地了解Exemplar2VQA管线的操作瓶颈,我们进行全面的故障模式分析. 我们分类了生成过程中所遇到出错的种类,并比较了单体(1个代理)和多代理(4个代理)配置之间的分布. 必须指出,如第4.4节所确定,在多代理框架下,失败的绝对数字大幅下降;因此,以下分析审查了剩余失败模式的比例。

blocks.en: Figure A3: Distribution of error types in the Exemplar2VQA pipeline.
blocks.zh: 图A3:Exemplar2VQA管道中出错类型的分布.

blocks.en: QA Generation Track Errors. The QA Generation Track relies on mathematical computations over scene metadata. We classify its failures into three distinct categories: Absence of Expected QA Pairs , where the agent fails to output any valid QA pairs—despite manual inspection confirming that the scene is indeed capable of generating the expected QA pairs; Code Execution Failure , occurring when the generated Python script crashes due to syntax errors, infinite loops, or incorrect API invocations; and Incorrect QA Pair Generation , where the code executes successfully but the resulting QA pairs contain logical flaws or mathematically incorrect ground-truth answers. In the monolithic setup, the dominant error is the Absence of Expected QA Pairs (47.0%), followed closely by Code Execution Failure (30.3%). This indicates that forcing a single LLM to simultaneously act as a semantic planner, a geometric coder, and a syntax debugger leads to severe cognitive overload. Transitioning to the multi-agent setup, the distribution shifts significantly. The proportion of Code Execution Failures decreases to 25.0%, and Absence of Expected QA Pairs drops to 37.5%.
blocks.zh: QA 生成轨道错误 。 QA生成轨迹依赖于数学计算而不是场景元数据. 我们将其失败分为三个不同的类别: 缺少预期的QA配对,即代理商未能输出任何有效的QA配对——尽管人工检查证实现场确实能够生成预期的QA配对; 代码执行失败,即生成的Python脚本由于语法错误,无限回路,或错误的API引用而崩溃; 错误的QA配对生成,即代码执行成功,但由此产生的QA配对包含逻辑缺陷或数学错误的地心真伪答案. 在单体设置中,最主要的错误是缺少预期的QA配对(47.0%),紧随其后的是代码执行失败(30.3%). 这表明,强迫单个LLM同时作为语义规划器,几何编码器和语法调试器,导致严重的认知超载. 向多代理设置过渡,分配方式发生显著转变. 密码执行失败的比例降至25.0%,预期质量评估对等的缺失率降至37.5%。

blocks.en: Camera Trajectory Generation Track Errors. The Camera Trajectory Generation Track interacts directly with the AI2-THOR physics engine. We categorize its failures into three types: Trajectory Semantic Misalignment , where the generated trajectory executes successfully but fails to capture the specific visual observations requested by the abstract instruction; Code Execution Failure , which involves Python syntax errors or logical breakdowns in the navigation loop; and FoV Occlusion & Invalid Observations , where the agent successfully moves, but the captured frames are invalid due to physical constraints such as staring directly into a wall, heavy occlusion, or out-of-bounds rendering. In the monolithic setup, embodied physical constraints are a major bottleneck, with Code Execution Failures (37.5%) and FoV Occlusion & Invalid Observations (15.0%) collectively accounting for over half of the errors. Conversely, the multi-agent setup demonstrates a profound ability to resolve these embodied physical errors. The closed-loop physics feedback provided to the Refiner agent drastically shrinks the proportion of FoV Occlusion down to a mere 6.2%, and Code Execution Failures drop to 31.2%. As the pipeline reliably solves physical collisions and syntax crashes, the remaining errors become overwhelmingly dominated by Trajectory Semantic Misalignment (62.5%). This highlights a critical frontier for Embodied AI: while multi-agent coding with physics feedback can guarantee a safe and executable trajectory, aligning an agent’s continuous spatial navigation perfectly with nuanced, abstract human semantic intent remains an inherently challenging problem.
blocks.zh: 相机轨迹生成轨道出错. 相机轨迹生成轨道与AI2-THOR物理引擎直接相互作用. 我们将其失败分为三类: 轨迹语义错误,生成的轨迹成功执行但未能捕捉到抽象指令所请求的具体视觉观察; 代码执行失败,涉及Python语法错误或导航回路中的逻辑分解; 和 FOV Occulusion & University Observation , 代理成功移动, 但被捕获的帧由于直接凝视一堵墙,重闭塞等物理约束而无效,或者外出渲染. 在单一结构中,有形的制约是一个主要瓶颈,代码执行失败(37.5%)和FOV 闭塞和无效观察(15.0%)共同造成一半以上的错误。 反之,多代理人的设置显示了解决这些有形错误的深刻能力。 向炼油剂提供的闭路物理反馈将FOV闭塞率大幅收缩到6.2%,代码执行失败率降至31.2%。 由于输油管可靠地解决了物理相撞和语法相撞,所剩误差以轨迹语义错位(62.5%)为主. 这凸显出健美AI的关键前沿:虽然多剂编码与物理反馈可以保证一个安全和可执行的轨迹,但完全按照精细而抽象的人类语义意图来调整剂的持续空间导航仍然是一个固有的挑战性问题。

blocks.en: A.6 Detailed Efficiency and Throughput Analysis
blocks.zh: A.6 详细效率和产出分析

blocks.en: In Section 4.6 , we briefly discussed the efficiency of the Exemplar2VQA framework. A critical advantage of Exemplar2VQA’s multi-agent coding paradigm is the structural decoupling of LLM-driven Code Synthesis (Phase 1) from Simulator-driven Data Execution (Phase 2). This separation ensures that the computationally expensive LLM inference acts strictly as a one-time initial overhead per spatial query template, while the subsequent large-scale dataset generation operates as a highly scalable programmatic execution.
blocks.zh: 在第4.6节中,我们简要地讨论了Exemplar2VQA框架的效率。 Exemplar2VQA的多代理编码范式的一个关键优势是LLM驱动的代码合成(第1阶段)与模拟器驱动的数据执行(第2阶段)的结构脱钩. 这种分离确保了计算成本昂贵的LLM推论严格起到每个空间查询模板的一次性初始间接费用的作用,而随后的大规模数据集生成则起到高度可扩展的程序执行作用.

blocks.en: Phase 1: Code Synthesis. This phase relies on the dual-track multi-agent system to interpret semantic templates and output bug-free Python scripts. • Camera Trajectory Track: It takes an average of 3 minutes per novel spatial task to complete the entire pipeline: semantic planning, code generation, and iterative interactive debugging within the AI2-THOR physics engine (e.g., resolving wall collisions or out-of-bounds errors). • QA Generation Track: Because this track relies on mathematical computations over scene metadata rather than embodied navigation, the agents can typically synthesize and debug the optimal geometric QA code in approximately 2 minute per task.

blocks.en: In summary, this bipartite architecture allows Exemplar2VQA to effectively leverage the intelligence of LLMs to establish a robust programmatic foundation, subsequently relying on pure CPU/GPU arithmetic to rapidly scale the spatial dataset to theoretically infinite bounds.
blocks.zh: 简言之,这种双相结构使得Exemplar2VQA能够有效地利用LLMs的智能来建立强大的程序基础,而后依靠纯CPU/GPU算术快速地将空间数据集缩放到理论上无限的界限.

blocks.en: A.7 Limitations
blocks.zh: A.7 限制

blocks.en: While Exemplar2VQA establishes a robust paradigm for scalable spatial QA synthesis, its current scope is predominantly optimized for static, object-centric configurations, leaving complex dynamic spatiotemporal events (e.g., continuous motion tracking) for future exploration. Furthermore, the generation framework currently relies on explicit 3D scene metadata extracted from simulators; directly ingesting raw real-world photographs to autonomously synthesize QA pairs will require integrating advanced upstream models. Finally, because the pipeline relies on multi-agent code execution to bypass spatial hallucinations, its absolute success rate remains inherently bounded by the coding capabilities of the foundational LLM, particularly when navigating highly convoluted algorithmic edge cases or physics engine glitches.
blocks.zh: 虽然Exemplar2VQA为可伸缩空间QA合成建立了强大的范式,但其目前的范围主要被优化为静态,以对象为中心的配置,留下了复杂的动态瞬间事件(如持续运动跟踪)来进行未来的探索. 此外,生成框架目前依赖于从模拟器中提取的清晰的3D场景元数据;直接摄取原始真实世界相片自主合成QA对将要求整合先进的上游模型. 最后,由于管道依赖于多剂密码执行来绕过空间幻觉,其绝对成功率在本质上仍然受基础LLM的编码能力所限制,特别是在导航高度曲折的算法边缘案例或物理引擎故障时.
